name: Sacred City of Anuradhapura
description: Anuradhapura, in Sri Lanka's north-central plain, was the island's capital for some 1,300 years and grew up around a cutting of the Buddha's enlightenment tree, brought here in the 3rd century B.C. That tree, the Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi, still lives and draws pilgrims. Abandoned after an invasion in 993 and swallowed by jungle, its ruined palaces, monasteries and monuments can be explored again.
